summary.en: Jordan has intensified its campaign against militants in southern Syria, conducting airstrikes and ground attacks that have killed several civilians, according to recent reports. The kingdom also arrested three suspects linked to the deadly church attack that killed nine people. Syrian authorities have imposed new restrictions on women’s university access and attended a security university graduation in Riyadh, while a car bomb and a drone strike on the Damascus-Homs highway killed multiple individuals. The conflict continues after the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, with 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Jordan har økt kampanjen mot militante grupper i sørlige Syria, med luftangrep og bakkekamp som har drept flere sivile, ifølge nylige rapporter. Kongeriket har også arrestert tre mistenkte knyttet til det dødelige kirkearrestet som drepte ni personer. Syriske myndigheter har innført nye restriksjoner på kvinners tilgang til universiteter og deltok på en sikkerhetsuniversitetsutdeling i Riyadh, mens en bilbombe og et droneangrep på motorveien Damaskus-Homs drepte flere personer. Konflikten fortsetter etter fallet av Assad-regimet i desember 2024, med 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
